mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_snapshot) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{addressSnapshot})
INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, food_id, food_name_snapshot, purchase_price, quantity, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{foodId}, #{foodNameSnapshot}, #{purchasePrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_snapshot, created_at, paid_at, completed_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_snapshot, created_at, paid_at, completed_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_snapshot, created_at, paid_at, completed_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, order_id, food_id, food_name_snapshot, purchase_price, quantity, subtotal FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = #{currentStatus}
UPDATE orders SET total_amount = #{totalAmount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND i.food_id = #{foodId}
